description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeTrackerLogsController class within the OrangeHRM project. The class extends AbstractVueController and implements CapableViewController, providing functionality to prepare and verify access to employee performance tracker logs, including retrieving tracker data and checking user permissions.

classes.name: EmployeeTrackerLogsController
classes.description: Controller handling the display and authorization of employee performance tracker logs, including data retrieval and access permission checks.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with performance tracker data before rendering, based on the 'id' request attribute.

methods.name: isCapable
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to access the specified performance tracker, throwing an exception if not.
